gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans keeps wide gaps where its curves meet the stems, and every stroke carries identical weight. But the hand-drawn Bpmf Iansui above it is what gives the pair its relaxed, inviting charm.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-synonym: Synonym brings a dependable sans-serif stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve, beneath the heading. Bpmf Iansui supplies the handwritten warmth.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-plus-jakarta-sans: Bpmf Iansui looks squeezed out of a tube in one steady, hand-drawn line, relaxed and inviting. Yet Plus Jakarta Sans answers it with precise, monoline sans letters whose curve endings stay well apart.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-space-grotesk: That toothpaste-like stroke in Bpmf Iansui gives every heading a loose, hand-drawn warmth. And Space Grotesk, a plain sans built as a ribbon of constant width, gives it a geometric footing, so a larger heading over smaller text would suit them.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-epunda-slab: Dignified and classic, Epunda Slab shows a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase under the ruler-straight, constant-width line of Bruno Ace. Low and high forms meet.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-fauna-one: Ruler-straight and unhurried, Bruno Ace lets curves and stems move in lockstep. Fauna One, a text serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, adds a literary hush beneath that display heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads big and open, with tall lowercase and wide, unclosed curves. Bruno Ace draws its line like a ballpoint with no pressure, and the two feel like a refined editorial layout beside a flat, deliberate display.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-hanuman: Bruno Ace lets its counters stay connected to the outside, giving a lingering rhythm of one character per beat. Hanuman's high-waisted lowercase makes the serif body noticeably taller, so a larger heading would suit.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a classic serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, sitting under the ruler-drawn Bruno Ace. Moderate meets high lowercase.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noticia-text: Bruno Ace has a blunt, round-tip marker feel from end to end, in a lingering one-character-per-beat rhythm. Noticia Text, a literary text serif with a big entrance into each curve, is the dignified tall-lowercase counterweight.
